name: IDLE_TXN_POOL_20261107
comment: ANCHOR: IDLE_TXN_POOL_20261107 — 2026-11-07 fan-out pools hand their worker's DB transaction back.
Postgres killed 160 idle-in-transaction backends in 3 h (588 on 11-06). pg_stat_activity sampling
attributed the pairs to one /api/v2/home/do-now build: its ThreadPoolExecutor workers are
long-lived, db_adapter gives each thread its own non-autocommit connection, and a read probe never
commits — so the worker idles until the 120 s role timeout kills it. Fix: end_thread_txn() in
db_adapter, watch_domains._db_query commits, and both pools submit through a wrapper that rolls
back in a finally. Hermetic: fake connections, a recording executor, no database.
